instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Keep a preset of show rules I can switch on, or change one I keep", and give it type (A kept type (a preset): { id, label, inherits?, rules }, id lowercase words joined by hyphens).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:keep-a-show-type and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Keeps one type (a preset: { id, label, inherits?, rules }) in your show-rules record; one with the id of a type you keep changes it.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: @own-records (workspace:read).
